integrity: All new exact examples were checked by independent finite encodings. The general theorem has a full deductive argument; no independent external audit or infinite computational certification is claimed.
limitations: Counts distinguish operations on the named fixed product lattice, not expansion isomorphism classes. Polynomial-time evaluation is for a fixed number of chain factors. The simplicity probability bound is non-sharp. The proof uses published WHB duality and congruence correspondence as premises, and literature novelty remains qualified by possible terminology variants.
title: Congruence-profile polynomial and generic simplicity for finite chain-product weak Heyting–Brouwer algebras
